correctness.rationale: Uniform proof: Ghrist 1999 establishes graph homotopy H_i=0 for i>1, H0=Q. Semialgebraic equivariant Euler Lefschetz gives 1-trH1=chi(fixed). Identity particle-label permutation fixes F_3(S_f), whose exact cubical Euler is -f(f+1)(2f-5). Label 2-cycles and 3-cycles require arm cycles of precisely matching lengths, yielding 2c2 and 3c3 contractible components. Transfer and falling factorial moments yield arm and alternating-arm quotient claims. Actual standalone code exhaustively checks one representative of each of 45 joint conjugacy-class pairs for m=3,4,5, with integral signed cellular traces and connected cubical models. Computation is corroboration, not proof of uniform claim.

value.rationale: The complete rational joint action for an entire two-parameter symmetry family is a natural invariant of collision-free motion on the canonical branching tree. It distinguishes particle-label sign and standard representations, not accessible from known unlabeled-only projections or Betti ranks. The disappearance under all arm symmetry and the exceptional A3/A4 quotient H1 are meaningful structural consequences, not arbitrary numerical slices.
